verdict.rationale: BILL documents a public v3 API that explicitly covers Spend & Expense: budgets, users, virtual cards, transactions and reimbursements. It also provides a sandbox, recipes, signed webhooks and agent-oriented docs (llms.txt and a documentation MCP server), so the product can clearly be driven programmatically. Most concrete endpoint examples are for AP rather than S&E, and the openapi.json/swagger.json paths probed all returned 404. Missing for 10: concrete S&E-specific endpoint documentation in evidence, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
